_source: Deal type → required documents per party (FR-9; Phase 1 spec 1d). Plain rules evaluated in code (lib/review/bundle.ts); the verdict cannot be SIGN until the bundle is complete.

rules.title: US healthcare / PHI
perParty: sub-BAA per subcontractor and affiliate that touches PHI
client's prior written consent for each subcontractor
rules.why: HIPAA: every business associate and subcontractor needs a written BAA before PHI access. AtliQ Inc delivers through Pvt Ltd (Pune), which is itself a subcontractor.

rules.title: EU personal data
rules.why: GDPR: processor terms and a transfer mechanism are needed before personal data reaches India or a sub-processor.

rules.title: India payment-system data
rules.why: RBI data-localisation rules for payment-system data.

rules.title: Any subcontractor on a client deal
rules.why: AtliQ can only give the client what its subcontractors give AtliQ.
